pages.text: Tier 4 cast material from Ice and Fire. At 1600°C alloy 100 mB molten dread, 125 mB liquid ectoplasm, 90 mB molten steel and 100 mB molten sapphire for 180 mB (two ingots).

Cast heads, bindings, handles, bow limbs, grips, maille, four armor platings, shield plating and shield cores. Use a gear cast for the core (360 mB), or a plate cast for shield plating (270 mB); assemble both into a plate shield.

Head: 355 durability, iron tier, 3 mining speed, 4 attack. Handle: +5% durability, attack damage and speed. Limb: 355 durability, +0.1 draw, +0.5 velocity, −0.1 accuracy. Grip: +5% durability, −0.1 accuracy, 2.5 attack. These parts and bindings grant $(l:trait_soul_strike)Soul Strike$().

Plating durability/armor: helmet 210/3, chest 325/8, legs 295/6, boots 215/2. Each has 1.5 toughness and 0.5 displayed knockback resistance. Shield plating has 300 durability, 1.5 toughness and 1 displayed knockback resistance. Maille and shield cores have no stats. All seven grant $(l:trait_soul_ward)Soul Ward$().
